_comment: Deep-dive (hands-on) YouTube/Vimeo videos per criticality. A criticality listed here ends its live flow on a final video slide and gets a link in the recap; a criticality NOT listed has neither. Per criticality: url = shared default; optional tokens = { <decisionToken>: url } shared per-token overrides; optional segments.<segmentId>.url = segment default; optional segments.<segmentId>.tokens = { <decisionToken>: url } segment+token overrides. Resolution mirrors the slide assets, most specific first: segment+token > token (shared) > segment default > base (shared). Decision tokens are the answer codes from content/config/decision-tree.json (e.g. bomN).
